lines.en: I drift slowly through the water
A thin membrane swells with air
I push the water with my cilia, stroke by stroke
I slip from the surface to the bottom

lines.zh: 水中留着我的一串气泡
lines.en: A string of my bubbles trails in the water
I drift across a stretch of shallows
My body is nearly transparent
The waterweeds part around me

lines.zh: 我朝岸边的方向偏过去
lines.en: I tilt toward the bank

lines.zh: 我漂得很慢，但一直在动
lines.en: I drift very slowly, but always moving

lines.zh: 我的纤毛排成一道道波
lines.en: My cilia ripple in waves
I drift east with the current

lines.zh: 我的身体被水推得一歪
lines.en: The water tips me to one side
I drift from the dark into the light

lines.zh: 我的膜边缘掠过了沙地
lines.en: The edge of my membrane grazes the sand
I skim across the surface
I hover in the middle of the water column

lines.zh: 薄壳里有一层细胞在动
lines.en: A layer of cells stirs in my thin shell
I sway gently with the current
The water tastes a little bitter
I barely need to do anything
Sunlight passes through me onto the sand
I swell once, slowly, and deflate
I wait for fish to pass
A little light rises on my surface
I float quietly
I stop beside the waterweeds

lines.zh: 水面上的光在我身上晃
lines.en: The light on the surface wavers over me
I am almost indistinguishable from the water
I wait without moving at all
What are you doing on the bank
Your shadow has fallen into the water
I am in the water, you are above it

lines.zh: 我的身体比你的手指还软
lines.en: My body is softer than your finger
Can you see me

lines.zh: 我在三格伤害里藏着危险
lines.en: Three points of harm hides in me
You have come near the water's edge

lines.zh: 你手上那团东西，是什么。
lines.en: That thing in your hand. What is it?
I drifted a little toward you
The ripples break up my shape
A hole opened in my membrane
Tissue spreads through the water
I clamp myself shut at once

lines.zh: 这点伤对二十点生命不轻
lines.en: This is heavy for twenty health
I sink toward the depths
My cilia thrashed for a while
The water washes the wound cold
I slowly gather myself again
I have leaked part of myself away
I keep dispersing into the water
Something is sinking into the water
Is that something to eat

lines.zh: 我朝那个方向调整了方向
lines.en: I adjust toward that direction
You put your hand in the water
I swing around under the surface
This is too small
I extend cilia to test it
I do not need much
You made the water shake
I came half a block closer
You touched my membrane
I shrink into a ball at once
Your finger pushed me askew
The water fills with broken bubbles

lines.zh: 碰一下，我的膜凹了进去。
lines.en: One touch, and my membrane dents inward.
I scatter and gather again
You are too warm
I retreat behind the waterweeds

lines.zh: 这一点碰撞让我偏了方向
lines.en: That bump turned me off course
I swell back up
My division needs no partner
I can grow another layer by myself

lines.zh: 水里到处都是我的碎片
lines.en: My fragments are everywhere in the water
Splitting needs no partner.
I pulsed once, as if laughing
My numbers increase on their own
I drift deeper

lines.zh: 这个问题的答案在水里
lines.en: The answer to that is in the water
I have no such organs
I drift on with the current
I wrap it in my membrane
The current brought it over
I curl a cilium around it
I can absorb this slowly
It dissolves inside my membrane
I drift a stretch with it
This one is a little hard
I press it into my body

lines.zh: 我拾起水底的一点碎末
lines.en: I gather a bit of debris from the bottom
This will serve me a long while
A shadow is moving on the bank
I aim at it from under the water
I strike from a distance
I have this distance measured
I need not surface
It stands in my line of fire
I gather my body in slowly
That small movement is enough
I move first, without waiting
It is already in my line of fire
I follow it under the water

lines.zh: 它每走一步我就调整一次
lines.en: I adjust with every step it takes
My membrane is tightening slightly
The light on the surface hides me
It has not seen me beneath the water
I am always at its flank and rear
This angle is the best to strike

lines.zh: 它的步子，我一下下数着。
lines.en: I count its steps, one by one.
Wait a little, the current will help me
My body is already lined up
I release a small burst of pressure
Three points land on its leg

lines.zh: 我从水里弹出来又落回
lines.en: I leap from the water and fall back
This one is light, but very accurate

lines.zh: 我的纤毛同时抽了一下
lines.en: My cilia lashed all at once
The splash got in its eyes
I drop back to the depths at once
This blow was only a test
I shove with my whole mass

lines.zh: 我被水弹回来，又冲过去
lines.en: The water bounces me back, I charge again
I rise beneath the surface

lines.zh: 这片水域每种地形都有我
lines.en: I am in every kind of water here
I bring one or two companions
There is a little more light in the water
My thin shell slowly fills
I drift with the waves, unnoticed
I am everywhere here
I spread myself out gently
I rise from the shallows to the midwater
Bubbles rise past me

lines.zh: 水一下子烫了，我的膜在缩
lines.en: The water turned hot, my membrane contracts

lines.zh: 我从高处落到水面，摔散了
lines.en: I fell from above onto the water and scattered

lines.zh: 水本该是我的家，太多了也压得慌
lines.en: Water is my home, but too much presses in
The underwater shock scattered me

lines.zh: 一根箭斜插进水里，擦过我
lines.en: An arrow slanted into the water and grazed me

lines.zh: 那股术力在水里传得很快
lines.en: That magic travels fast through water

lines.zh: 水里没什么可吸收的，我在变薄
lines.en: Nothing to absorb, I am thinning

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整个麻了
lines.en: Lightning struck the water and numbed me all over
The water is gone and I hang in the air
